citation: Raza et al. 2012, J. Power Sources 201:121

materials.notes: Cell: 13 mm diameter, 0.64 cm2 active area, 0.08 cm (800 um) total thickness (electrolyte-supported), cell sintered 650 C 30 min. Ag paste current collectors. Paper reports Pmax at 550 C of 900/850/800 mW/cm2 for the three samples but only explicitly states 'sample 2 sintered at 700 C have much better performance' -> Sample-2 = 900. Assignment of 850 to Sample-1 and 800 to Sample-3 is inferred (natural order); mapping is not certain from the text alone.

materials.composition_label: CSDC-Na2CO3 Sample-2 (sintered 700 C 3 h, best performer)
materials.notes: Best-performing sample per text. Conductivity pellet separate from cell: 2.0 mm thick, 13 mm diameter, EIS 0.01 Hz - 1 MHz. Conductivity value 0.35 S/cm read from Fig 7 stability test at 550 C in H2 (starts ~0.35, drops to ~0.30 after 21 h; 'reduced marginally'). Paper also states general experimental range 'total conductivity 0.3-0.5 S/cm at 500-600 C' (used in Eq. 1 calculation). Ea = 0.238 eV from Arrhenius plot (paper does not resolve per-sample Ea; assigning to Sample-2 which is the reference material). Conductivity type: paper explicitly identifies dual H+/O2- (co-ionic) conduction. Durability 21 h at 550 C (7 h/day x 3 days) from stability test; conductivity reduced marginally over that period. Table 1 also reports CSDC-alone phase conductivity: 0.05 S/cm (air), 0.18 S/cm (H2) - these are CSDC without carbonate. Extraction confidence: low for this material because conductivity read from figure.
Pmax = 800 mW/cm2 at 550 C is inferred assignment (see Sample-1 note). Same base composition as Sample-1/-2 but sintered at highest temperature; often carbonate loss at high T reduces performance.

extraction_notes: Three samples of the same CSDC-Na2CO3 composition sintered at 600/700/800 C. Paper reports Pmax values 900/850/800 mW/cm2 without explicitly mapping them to Sample-1/2/3; only Sample-2 (700 C, best) is explicitly identified with 900 mW/cm2. Assignment of 850 -> Sample-1 and 800 -> Sample-3 is inferred. Conductivity value 0.35 S/cm read from Fig 7 stability test (approximate). Activation energy 0.238 eV reported globally and assigned to Sample-2 (the reference/best sample). Fuel H2 (100 mL/min, 1 atm), oxidant air. dopant_fraction 0.2 per formula label (same convention as ref07). OCV values, relative density, secondary phase wt%, and per-sample conductivities not stated. Confidence: low because critical values (conductivity, sample-Pmax mapping) required figure reading or inference. Also cites the same paper-level composition inconsistency as ref07 (formula Ce0.8... vs. no explicit x).
